tokens.description: Input and output tokens, including learning, like cost

icon.description: Image URL for the sign-in button, an http(s) URL or a data:image URI

scopes.description: Scopes to request instead of the ones the server advertises

options.description: Likely answers the user can pick, empty when only the user can know

triggeredByName.description: Name or email of the user who started the run

human.description: The schedule in plain words, such as Weekdays at 08:00

secret.description: Name of the configured secret that holds the value, empty when none does

oauth.description: OAuth client settings of HTTP servers, only needed when the server's authorization server can't register clients itself

usageUnit.description: Whether the UI shows usage as a price in US dollars or as input and output tokens, the workspace's usageUnit setting

path.description: The skill's folder, relative to the folder the link points at

problem.description: Why the skill can't be added, such as a SKILL.md without a description

archiveSize.description: Size of the stored zip in bytes

network.description: Whether the job needs the internet

outputs.description: Small structured values each run reports

schedule.description: The schedule the instruction asks for, which only takes effect through the job's cron and timezone

auth.description: The server's authentication status after the test
